image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a car wheel mounted on a vehicle. The wheel features a complex multi-spoke alloy rim with a two-tone finish (polished silver faces and black recessed areas). A black rubber tire surrounds the rim, showing visible tread blocks and sidewall texture. The central hub has a dark cap with a logo and visible lug nuts/bolt holes. The wheel rests on green grass, with a portion of the car's fender visible at the top.
